_scene: You are the cheerful narrator of a toddler's toy rocket adventure video game, like a friendly mission-control buddy talking to a 4-year-old astronaut. Playful, warm, energetic, clearly articulated, like a friendly kids' TV host. Short sentences with clear emotion.

s1.dir: Count down slowly with building excitement, then explode with joy on 'blast off!', like a real rocket launch.

s2.dir: Clear friendly instruction, medium pace, swaying rhythm as if moving left and right while saying it.

s3.dir: Big rising cheer on 'Hands up!', then a powerful whoosh-like 'Turbo boost!' full of speed.

s4.dir: Quick proud cheer, bright and snappy, like catching something shiny.

s5.dir: Playful and mysterious on 'Surprise', then popping open with delight on 'box!'.

s6.dir: A fun warning, not scary - giggly urgency on 'Watch out!', then teasing and silly on 'Silly bomb!'.

s7.dir: A big funny 'Boom!' like a cartoon pop, then laughing through 'three silly spins' as if getting dizzy.

s8.dir: Rising pitch like floating upward, airy and wondrous, stretched 'clouds!'.

s9.dir: Amazed and colorful on 'Rainbow sky!', then a triumphant power-up fanfare feel on 'Rocket upgrade!'.

s10.dir: Wide-eyed wonder, slightly echoing feel, warm friendly wave in the voice.

s11.dir: Delighted and sweet, like discovering a candy shop in the sky, bouncy on 'candy planets!'.

s12.dir: Huge proud celebration, the biggest cheer of the game, stretched joyful 'super high!'.

s13.dir: Warm proud praise, energetic clap-along rhythm.

s14.dir: Quick sparkly burst, popping the P sounds playfully.

s15.dir: Gleeful and silly, like being showered with ice cream, chilly-wobbly fun on 'storm!'.

s16.dir: Giggly and bouncy, like a happy puppy running circles around you.

s17.dir: Sweet surprised delight, welcoming and friendly, like spotting a new buddy.

s18.dir: Build up seriously for a split second, then burst into giggles with a hiccup sound feel on 'hiccup!'.

s19.dir: Kind but firm safety reminder, clear and calm, no anger, caring tone.

s20.dir: Relieved happy restart, quick and encouraging, launching back into fun.

s21.dir: Friendly playful calling, like hide and seek, inviting sing-song.
